snippet.description:
#outcast #talhahyunus #jokhay 

Written/Performed by Talhah Yunus
Produced by Jokhay

Lyrics:

Mic check 1 2, ustaad nahi guru,
Hogi baat rubaru, mera khauf huu ba huu,
Ghumay baat Hula hooop, besabaat kia kahun? kese yaad na rahun,
Ziada baat na karun, kia bedaadgar lagu,
Phelain saaray aag ki tarah na kar shuruu,
Ab dunya diwani mojaza e fan kahuuu,
Badla na mizaaj, kia hisaab mai rakhu,
Sina soz, Dil faroz, saari mehfillon ki jaan,
Le ye naaam dekh badlengay ab roop,
Shab o roz, kha ke chot, den sabr k imtehaan,
Bhar te jaam, intiqam khud se lu,
Khud se raabtay mai hu, jana subh ki ye bedari,
Haan mai paapi mai khilaari,
Han mai baaghi mai jihadi,
Dunya jaali, woh diwaaani,
Karte behas ye anaari,
Dil pe pathar, woh bhi bhaari,
Zimmedari, kalakari ye,
Baat ye hai ke log badal gaye,
Zulm ye hai ke woh maante nahin,
Rakh hogaye ghar bhi jal gaye, 
Beqadar hunar pehchante nahin,
Bethe shaam se waheeen,
gham e shaam tou nahi, 
Khelen jaan pe kayi, ye inaam tou nahi, 
Kese rokogay ghari ye,
Sab maangte nahi, 
Mehngay hon libaas,
Andar jhank tou kabhi,
Yaad kar kabhi, sachay dil se,
Lagay hain illzaam baray, banay baray firqay,
Yahan Sarken barbaad khoon charra sab ke sarr pe,
Qeemat nahi hai jaan ki koi Seekhe hue girr ke,
Chamber hai loaded, yahan chor bhi daku bhi,
Zinda duaon par ponchengay ansu bhi,
Aa kabhi jhaank un maaon ki ankhon mai,
Lashon pe lashen, pani pheren khuabon pe,
Nai aata baaton mai, nai ata jhanson mai,
Seekha jo sarkon se woh nai kitaabon pe,
Qaid imtehanon mai, sooni in raaton mai
Zinda dilaason pe kitne..
Kalakaar mere jese idhar kitne?
Shooter hai bhai aja dekh meri fitness,
Kuch mai ho ungal aatay woh pitnay,
Shehr nahi ye jungle, kha chuka kitne,
Waqt ye badalta sab karchuka witness 
Khuddaar hu mai kia ye meri weakness,
Presence aur blessings jani asal greatness,
TY in the building, all these motherfuckers wasted,
Banda khatarnaak bara, palla issi shehr mai,
Still at the top, abhi kooda tou nahi,
Laya phir se wave nayi, aja beta terr le,
Kia tu aag mai dooba hai kabhi ?


Dunya ye jhooti, sab ko apni hai pari,
Kia sab munafiq, chand hi mukhlis aaj bhi,
Jhutay fasanay sab sunaengay laazmi,
Paisa k aagay jhuk gaya kia aadmi,
Aadmi, aadmi
Badla na khud ko aaaj bhi,
Aaj bhi, aaj bhi
Kia hai koi qeemat jaan ki?
